description:
Render a per-branch state indicator in the git tree.

=== Scope ===

Per ARCH §12 v0.5 success criterion: "branch-state indicators". Per §3.5 branch state is read from refs/heads/ and on-disk artifacts — no separate state file.

States to render:
- in_flight: branch HEAD has an active step directory whose terminal artifact is absent (matches the in-flight rule used by bl-0619).
- merged: branch is reachable from main's HEAD (i.e. merge-base(branch, main) == branch HEAD).
- stopped: branch has a stop marker on disk. Pin the marker's name/location against §2.3/§2.6 in implementation; do not coin silently — if the spec doesn't already pin it, surface that and amend ARCH first.
- conflicted: a merge of branch into its target left a conflict marker (e.g. .git/MERGE_HEAD plus unresolved index entries on the integrating branch's checkout).

The four states are mutually exclusive at render time; precedence rules are pinned in the implementation and reflected in tests.

=== Tests ===

- Fixture repos exercising each state; from_repo classifies correctly.
- Renderer test per state: the right glyph/colour shows up.

=== Out of scope ===

- New ref naming or new on-disk markers. If something the spec doesn't already pin is needed, escalate to a docs amendment.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: UI: branch-state indicators (in-flight / merged / stopped / conflicted)
